summary: Fulton Financial Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $300M offering of 5.950% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes feature a fixed rate for five years, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 217 bps. They are unsecured subordinated obligations ranking pari passu with existing subordinated debt and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. The company may redeem on or after May 2031 at par; optional redemption also permitted upon Tier 2 Capital or tax events. No public market exists; notes not listed. Underwriting discount is 1%. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
